data.long_meaning: Vl is a powerful and strong name. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'vira', which means hero. The name Vl carries the meaning “Power, Strength” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Vl usually hope their child will grow to embody power, strength and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Vl is a sacred name in Hinduism. It is believed to bring strength, courage, and wisdom to the bearer. It is also believed to protect the bearer from harm and to bring success in all endeavors.
data.etymology: Vl belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Power, Strength.”
